title: Lost Mary Maryliq x Crystal Cherry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid - 20mg
description: Maryliq x Crystal Cherry Ice by Lost Mary is a refined and intensified version of a fan-favourite fruit blend. As part of the Maryliq Crystal collection, this e-liquid features a revitalised recipe designed to maximise flavour clarity. It captures the bold, ruby-red taste of ripe cherries, delivering a deep and juicy sweetness on the inhale. The experience is expertly rounded off with a crisp, cooling menthol breeze on the exhale, creating a balanced vape that is both rich and refreshing. Mixed with a 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this e-liquid ensures that the complex cherry notes shine through clearly without being muted. It is perfectly suited for use with MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices such as refillable pod kits. The 20mg nicotine salt strength provides a smooth, comfortable draw and fast-acting nicotine delivery.
